<script lang="ts">
  import { mount, type Snippet, unmount, untrack } from 'svelte';
  import type { HTMLAttributes } from 'svelte/elements';
  import { ScrollArea } from '#lib/components/ui/scroll-area/index.js';
  import { cn } from '#lib/utils.js';
  import {
    type ComposerTokenPart,
    useComposerEditorContext,
    useComposerSuggestionsContext
  } from './composer-editor.svelte.js';
  import ComposerTokenHost from './composer-token-host.svelte';

  type Props = Omit<HTMLAttributes<HTMLElement>, 'contenteditable'> & {
    ref?: HTMLElement | null;
    /** Render a native `<textarea>` instead of a contenteditable `<div>`. */
    as?: 'div' | 'textarea';
    placeholder?: string;
    renderToken?: Snippet<[ComposerTokenPart]>;
  };

  let {
    ref = $bindable(null),
    as: tag = 'div',
    class: className,
    placeholder,
    renderToken,
    ...restProps
  }: Props = $props();

  const editor = useComposerEditorContext();
  const suggestions = useComposerSuggestionsContext();

  const textarea = $derived(tag === 'textarea');

  type Handlers = Record<string, ((event: never) => void) | undefined>;
  const user = (key: string) => (restProps as Handlers)[key];
  const own: Handlers = { ...editor?.handlers };

  // Run the caller's handler first, then suggestions, then the editor (right-to-left merge).
  const handlers: Handlers = {};
  for (const key of Object.keys(own)) {
    handlers[key] = (event: never) => {
      user(key)?.(event);
      if (key === 'onkeydown' && !textarea) suggestions?.onKeyDown(event as KeyboardEvent);
      own[key]?.(event);
    };
  }

  const attributes = $derived(
    textarea
      ? { disabled: editor?.disabled, readonly: editor?.readOnly, placeholder }
      : {
          ...editor?.inputAttributes,
          ...suggestions?.inputAttributes,
          contenteditable: editor?.inputAttributes.contenteditable ?? true
        }
  );

  // --- layout: line height measurement + adaptive single/multi-line switch ---
  let scrollElement = $state<HTMLElement | null>(null);
  let scheduleMeasure: (() => void) | null = null;

  $effect(() => {
    const scroll = scrollElement;
    const input = editor?.inputElement;
    if (!scroll || !input) return;
    const frame = scroll.closest<HTMLElement>('[data-slot="composer"]');
    // eslint-disable-next-line svelte/prefer-svelte-reactivity -- local to the effect, not reactive state
    const controls = new Set<HTMLElement>();
    let animationFrame: number | null = null;

    function schedule(): void {
      if (animationFrame !== null) return;
      animationFrame = requestAnimationFrame(() => {
        animationFrame = null;
        measure();
      });
    }

    const observer = new ResizeObserver(schedule);

    function measure(): void {
      if (!scroll || !input) return;
      // Observe the groups themselves: their wrapper has no box in compact mode.
      const nextControls = new Set(
        frame?.querySelectorAll<HTMLElement>(
          ':scope > [data-slot="composer-actions"] > [data-slot="composer-action-group"]'
        )
      );
      for (const control of controls) {
        if (!nextControls.has(control)) {
          observer.unobserve(control);
          controls.delete(control);
        }
      }
      for (const control of nextControls) {
        if (!controls.has(control)) {
          observer.observe(control);
          controls.add(control);
        }
      }
      const style = getComputedStyle(input);
      const lineHeight =
        Number.parseFloat(style.lineHeight) || Number.parseFloat(style.fontSize) * 1.2;
      const padding = Number.parseFloat(style.paddingTop) + Number.parseFloat(style.paddingBottom);
      for (const [property, value] of [
        ['--composer-line-height', `${lineHeight}px`],
        ['--composer-input-padding', `${padding}px`]
      ] as const) {
        if (scroll.style.getPropertyValue(property) !== value) {
          scroll.style.setProperty(property, value);
        }
      }
      if (!frame || frame.dataset.layout !== 'adaptive' || !controls.size) {
        frame?.removeAttribute('data-multiline');
        return;
      }
      const minRows = Number.parseFloat(style.getPropertyValue('--composer-min-rows'));
      if (minRows > 1) {
        frame.toggleAttribute('data-multiline', true);
        return;
      }

      // Measure at the narrow, one-line width even after the actions move below.
      // This keeps the layout from oscillating when full-width text fits one line.
      frame.removeAttribute('data-multiline');
      const minHeight = input.style.getPropertyValue('min-height');
      const minHeightPriority = input.style.getPropertyPriority('min-height');
      input.style.setProperty('min-height', '0px', 'important');
      const contentHeight = input.scrollHeight;
      if (minHeight) {
        input.style.setProperty('min-height', minHeight, minHeightPriority);
      } else {
        input.style.removeProperty('min-height');
      }
      frame.toggleAttribute('data-multiline', contentHeight > lineHeight * 1.5 + padding);
    }

    scheduleMeasure = schedule;
    measure();
    observer.observe(input);
    if (frame) observer.observe(frame);
    input.addEventListener('input', schedule);
    window.addEventListener('resize', schedule);
    document.fonts.addEventListener('loadingdone', schedule);
    return () => {
      scheduleMeasure = null;
      if (animationFrame !== null) cancelAnimationFrame(animationFrame);
      observer.disconnect();
      input.removeEventListener('input', schedule);
      window.removeEventListener('resize', schedule);
      document.fonts.removeEventListener('loadingdone', schedule);
    };
  });

  // Controlled drafts, layout props and conditional actions can change without an input event.
  $effect(() => {
    void editor?.value;
    void editor?.disabled;
    void className;
    scheduleMeasure?.();
  });

  // --- tokens: mount the token renderer into each host span inside the editable ---
  // eslint-disable-next-line svelte/prefer-svelte-reactivity -- bookkeeping for mounted token hosts, intentionally non-reactive
  const mounted = new Map<HTMLElement, Record<string, unknown>>();

  function readToken(node: HTMLElement): ComposerTokenPart {
    return {
      type: node.dataset.composerToken === 'action' ? 'action' : 'mention',
      id: node.dataset.id ?? '',
      label: node.dataset.label ?? '',
      trigger: node.dataset.trigger ?? '@',
      ...(node.dataset.kind ? { kind: node.dataset.kind } : {}),
      ...(node.dataset.data !== undefined ? { data: node.dataset.data } : {}),
      ...(node.dataset.text !== undefined ? { text: node.dataset.text } : {})
    };
  }

  $effect(() => {
    const hosts = editor?.tokenHosts ?? [];
    untrack(() => {
      for (const host of hosts) {
        if (mounted.has(host)) continue;
        const node = host.parentElement;
        if (!node) continue;
        const fallback = host.previousElementSibling;
        if (fallback instanceof HTMLElement) fallback.hidden = true;
        const token = readToken(node);
        mounted.set(
          host,
          mount(ComposerTokenHost, {
            target: host,
            props: {
              token,
              get renderToken() {
                return renderToken;
              }
            }
          })
        );
      }
      for (const [host, instance] of mounted) {
        if (hosts.includes(host)) continue;
        void unmount(instance);
        mounted.delete(host);
      }
    });
  });

  $effect(() => () => {
    for (const instance of mounted.values()) void unmount(instance);
    mounted.clear();
  });
</script>

      className
    )}
    {...restProps}
    {...attributes}
    {...handlers}
  ></svelte:element>
</ScrollArea>

<script lang="ts">
  import type { Snippet } from 'svelte';
  import type { HTMLButtonAttributes } from 'svelte/elements';
  import { cn } from '#lib/utils.js';
  import {
    type ComposerItemValue,
    useComposerSuggestionsContext
  } from './composer-editor.svelte.js';

  type Props = Omit<HTMLButtonAttributes, 'value'> & {
    ref?: HTMLButtonElement | null;
    value?: ComposerItemValue;
    children?: Snippet<[{ highlighted: boolean; disabled: boolean }]>;
  };

  let {
    ref = $bindable(null),
    class: className,
    value,
    disabled: disabledProp,
    children,
    ...restProps
  }: Props = $props();

  const suggestions = useComposerSuggestionsContext();

  const disabled = $derived(Boolean(disabledProp || value?.disabled));
  const id = $derived(value?.id);
  const highlighted = $derived(id !== undefined && id === suggestions?.highlightedId);

  function register(element: HTMLElement) {
    const itemId = id;
    const isDisabled = disabled;
    if (itemId === undefined || !suggestions) return;
    suggestions.registerItem(itemId, { element, disabled: isDisabled });
    return () => suggestions.registerItem(itemId, null);
  }
</script>

<button
  bind:this={ref}
  {@attach register}
  type="button"
  data-slot="composer-item"
  id={id !== undefined && suggestions
    ? `${suggestions.listId}-${encodeURIComponent(id)}`
    : undefined}
  role={suggestions ? 'option' : undefined}
  tabindex={suggestions ? -1 : undefined}
  aria-selected={suggestions ? highlighted : undefined}
  aria-disabled={disabled || undefined}
  data-highlighted={highlighted ? '' : undefined}
  data-disabled={disabled ? '' : undefined}
  {disabled}
  class={cn(
    'flex min-h-8 w-full cursor-default select-none items-center gap-2 rounded-sm px-2 py-1 text-start text-base outline-none data-disabled:pointer-events-none data-highlighted:bg-accent data-highlighted:text-accent-foreground data-disabled:opacity-64 sm:min-h-7 sm:text-sm',
    className
  )}
  onpointermove={() => {
    if (!disabled && value) suggestions?.highlightItem(value);
  }}
  onclick={() => {
    if (!disabled && value) suggestions?.selectItem(value);
  }}
  onmousedown={(event) => {
    if (suggestions) event.preventDefault();
  }}
  {...restProps}
>
  {@render children?.({ highlighted, disabled })}
</button>

<script lang="ts">
  import { Popover as PopoverPrimitive } from '@shardsui/svelte/popover';
  import type { ComponentProps, Snippet } from 'svelte';

  import { useComposerEditorContext } from './composer-editor.svelte.js';

    children?: Snippet;

    side?: ComponentProps<typeof PopoverPrimitive.Positioner>['side'];
    align?: ComponentProps<typeof PopoverPrimitive.Positioner>['align'];
    sideOffset?: ComponentProps<typeof PopoverPrimitive.Positioner>['sideOffset'];

  let {
    ref = $bindable(null),

    side = 'top',
    align = 'start',
    sideOffset = 4,
    alignOffset = 0,
    positionerClass,
    portalProps,

</script>

<script lang="ts">
  import type { Snippet } from 'svelte';
  import type { HTMLButtonAttributes } from 'svelte/elements';
  import type { ButtonSize, ButtonVariant } from '#lib/components/ui/button/button-variants.js';
  import { Button } from '#lib/components/ui/button/index.js';
  import { useComposerEditorContext } from './composer-editor.svelte.js';

  type Props = Omit<HTMLButtonAttributes, 'type' | 'class'> & {
    class?: string;
    ref?: HTMLElement | null;
    variant?: ButtonVariant;
    size?: ButtonSize;
    loading?: boolean;
    children?: Snippet;
  };

  let { ref = $bindable(null), disabled, onclick, ...restProps }: Props = $props();

  const editor = useComposerEditorContext();
</script>

<Button
  bind:ref
  data-slot="composer-submit"
  type="button"
  disabled={disabled ?? !editor?.canSubmit}
  onpointerdown={(event: PointerEvent) => {
    // Keep the caret in the input while pressing Send.
    const input = editor?.inputElement;
    if (
      event.button === 0 &&
      input &&
      input === (event.currentTarget as HTMLElement).ownerDocument.activeElement
    ) {
      event.preventDefault();
    }
  }}
  onclick={(event: MouseEvent & { currentTarget: EventTarget & HTMLButtonElement }) => {
    onclick?.(event);
    if (event.defaultPrevented || disabled) return;
    event.preventDefault();
    editor?.submit();
  }}
  {...restProps}
/>

<script lang="ts">
  import { Popover as PopoverPrimitive } from '@shardsui/svelte/popover';
  import type { Snippet } from 'svelte';
  import type { HTMLFormAttributes } from 'svelte/elements';
  import { cn } from '#lib/utils.js';
  import {
    type ComposerChangeDetails,
    ComposerEditor,
    type ComposerEditorOptions,
    type ComposerItemValue,
    type ComposerQuery,
    ComposerSuggestions,
    type ComposerTrigger,
    type ComposerValue,
    focusComposerInput,
    getComposerText,
    setComposerEditorContext,
    setComposerSuggestionsContext
  } from './composer-editor.svelte.js';

  type Props = Omit<HTMLFormAttributes, 'onsubmit' | 'name' | 'children'> & {
    ref?: HTMLFormElement | null;
    layout?: 'stacked' | 'adaptive';
    value?: ComposerValue;
    defaultValue?: ComposerValue;
    onValueChange?: (value: ComposerValue, details: ComposerChangeDetails) => void;
    onSubmit?: (value: ComposerValue) => void;
    onQueryChange?: (query: ComposerQuery | null) => void;
    onAction?: (item: ComposerItemValue, query: ComposerQuery) => void;
    submitOnEmptySuggestions?: boolean;
    triggers?: readonly ComposerTrigger[];
    disabled?: boolean;
    readOnly?: boolean;
    submitDisabled?: boolean;
    allowEmpty?: boolean;
    submitOnEnter?: ComposerEditorOptions['submitOnEnter'];
    name?: string;
    getSuggestionsAnnouncement?: (count: number) => string;
    /** Receives the editor state, so descendants can call `insertTrigger`, `reset`, ... */
    children?: Snippet<[ComposerEditor]>;
  };

  let {
    ref = $bindable(null),
    class: className,
    layout = 'stacked',
    value = $bindable(),
    defaultValue = [],
    onValueChange,
    onSubmit,
    onQueryChange,
    onAction,
    submitOnEmptySuggestions,
    triggers,
    disabled,
    readOnly,
    submitDisabled,
    allowEmpty,
    submitOnEnter,
    name,
    getSuggestionsAnnouncement,
    children,
    ...restProps
  }: Props = $props();

  const listId = $props.id();

  // Uncontrolled drafts live here; a bound/passed `value` takes precedence.
  // svelte-ignore state_referenced_locally
  let uncontrolled = $state.raw<ComposerValue>(defaultValue);

  const editor = new ComposerEditor(() => ({
    value: value ?? uncontrolled,
    defaultValue,
    onValueChange: (next, details) => {
      uncontrolled = next;
      value = next;
      onValueChange?.(next, details);
    },
    onSubmit,
    onQueryChange,
    onAction,
    submitOnEmptySuggestions,
    triggers,
    disabled,
    readOnly,
    submitDisabled,
    allowEmpty,
    submitOnEnter
  }));

  const suggestions = new ComposerSuggestions(() => ({
    ...editor.suggestions,
    listId,
    getSuggestionsAnnouncement
  }));

  setComposerEditorContext(editor);
  setComposerSuggestionsContext(suggestions);

  // Native `form.reset()` restores the default draft.
  $effect(() => {
    const form = editor.rootElement;
    if (!form) return;
    const onReset = (event: Event) => {
      queueMicrotask(() => {
        if (!event.defaultPrevented) editor.reset();
      });
    };
    form.addEventListener('reset', onReset);
    return () => form.removeEventListener('reset', onReset);
  });
</script>
